package mariamem_test

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"strings"
	"github.com/masahitojp/mariamem/internal/generatedgo"
	"testing"
	"time"

	mysql "github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql"
	mariamem "github.com/masahitojp/mariamem"
)

func publicDB(t *testing.T, opts mariamem.Options) *mariamem.Database {
	t.Helper()
	db, e := mariamem.Start(context.Background(), opts)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
	return db
}
func publicPool(t *testing.T, db *mariamem.Database, pipe bool) *sql.DB {
	t.Helper()
	cfg, e := mysql.ParseDSN(db.DSN())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	cfg.InterpolateParams = false
	if pipe {
		cfg.DialFunc = db.DialContext
	}
	connector, e := mysql.NewConnector(cfg)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	pool := sql.OpenDB(connector)
	pool.SetMaxIdleConns(0)
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = pool.Close() })
	return pool
}
func TestNativePublicGoRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	db := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{})
	for _, pipe := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(pipe), func(t *testing.T) {
			pool := publicPool(t, db, pipe)
			connection, e := pool.Conn(context.Background())
			if e != nil {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
			defer connection.Close()
			var n int
			if e := connection.QueryRowContext(context.Background(), "SELECT ? + ?", 13, 29).Scan(&n); e != nil || n != 42 {
				t.Fatalf("prepared: %d %v", n, e)
			}
			if _, e := connection.ExecContext(context.Background(), "SELECT * FROM no_such_public_table"); e == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing ordinary SQL error")
			}
			if e := db.Err(); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("ordinary error poisoned owner: %v", e)
			}
			if e := connection.QueryRowContext(context.Background(), "SELECT 17").Scan(&n); e != nil || n != 17 {
				t.Fatal(n, e)
			}
		})
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if e := db.WaitDisconnected(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
func TestNativePublicSharedCapacity(t *testing.T) {
	db := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{})
	tcp := publicPool(t, db, false)
	pipe := publicPool(t, db, true)
	var conns []*sql.Conn
	defer func() {
		for _, c := range conns {
			_ = c.Close()
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		p := tcp
		if i%2 == 1 {
			p = pipe
		}
		c, e := p.Conn(context.Background())
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(i, e)
		}
		conns = append(conns, c)
	}
	info := db.ConnectionInfo()
	addr := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", info.Host, info.Port)
	if c, e := db.DialContext(context.Background(), "tcp", addr); c != nil || !errors.Is(e, mariamem.ErrCapacity) {
		t.Fatalf("pipe capacity: %v %v", c, e)
	}
	c, e := net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, time.Second)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer c.Close()
	_ = c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	packet := make([]byte, 256)
	n, e := io.ReadFull(c, packet[:7])
	if e != nil || n < 7 || packet[4] != 255 || int(packet[5])|int(packet[6])<<8 != 1040 {
		t.Fatalf("TCP capacity: %x %v", packet[:n], e)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	if c, e := db.DialContext(ctx, "tcp", addr); c != nil || !errors.Is(e, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("canceled dial: %v %v", c, e)
	}
}
func TestNativePublicFatalCauseAndIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, pipe := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(pipe), func(t *testing.T) {
			db := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{QueryTimeout: 120 * time.Millisecond})
			pool := publicPool(t, db, pipe)
			peer := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{})
			healthy := publicPool(t, peer, false)
			if _, e := pool.Exec("DO SLEEP(2)"); e == nil {
				t.Fatal("deadline query succeeded")
			}
			if e := db.Err(); !errors.Is(e, mariamem.ErrUnusable) || !errors.Is(e, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				t.Fatalf("owner cause: %v", e)
			}
			if e := healthy.Ping(); e != nil {
				t.Fatalf("independent instance: %v", e)
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestNativePublicDefaultTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	db := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{})
	pool := publicPool(t, db, false)
	if _, e := pool.Exec("DO SLEEP(10.2)"); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("public30s default: %v", e)
	}
}

// Installer substitutes the registered tuple, never the runtime's own value.
func TestNativePublicSelectedIdentity(t *testing.T) {
 if generatedgo.GuestSHA256 != "EXPECTED_SELECTED_GUEST_SHA256" { t.Fatal("wrong compiled selected guest") }
 db := publicDB(t, mariamem.Options{})
 for _, pipe := range []bool{false,true} {
  var version string
  if e := publicPool(t,db,pipe).QueryRow("SELECT VERSION()").Scan(&version); e != nil { t.Fatal(e) }
  if !strings.HasPrefix(version,"EXPECTED_SELECTED_ENGINE-") { t.Fatalf("wrong selected engine: %s",version) }
 }
}
